project_read.name: See the projects
project_read.description: Read the selected projects and their settings.

agent_create.name: Create agents
agent_create.description: Add new agents to the selected projects, including copies of the agents you own or administer there.

agent_settings_draft_update.name: Edit agent drafts
agent_settings_draft_update.description: Change the draft settings of the agents you own or administer in the selected projects (model, instructions). Publishing stays in the studio.

document_read.name: Read documents
document_read.description: Access titles, content, and metadata of documents in this workspace.

document_create.name: Create documents
document_create.description: Add new documents to the workspace. Existing documents won't be modified.

document_update.name: Update documents
document_update.description: Edit the content of existing documents in this workspace.

document_delete.name: Delete documents
document_delete.description: Permanently remove documents from this workspace.

document_source_read.name: Read document sources
document_source_read.description: See the document sources registered on this workspace.

document_source_create.name: Create document sources
document_source_create.description: Register a named document source on this workspace.

document_source_update.name: Update document sources
document_source_update.description: Rename a document source or change its settings.

document_source_delete.name: Delete document sources
document_source_delete.description: Remove a document source that has no documents attached.

document_tag_read.name: Read document tags
document_tag_read.description: See the document tags in this workspace.

document_tag_create.name: Create document tags
document_tag_create.description: Add a document tag to this workspace.

document_tag_update.name: Update document tags
document_tag_update.description: Rename a document tag or change its description and parent.

document_tag_delete.name: Delete document tags
document_tag_delete.description: Remove a document tag from this workspace.

project_read.name: Read workspace
project_read.description: See this workspace and its settings.

agent_read.name: Read agents
agent_read.description: See the agents of this workspace.

agent_conversation_session_external_crea.description: People who write to this app can chat with the agents of this workspace, without a Bayes account.
